tools.name: find
tools.description: Find MCP servers or web APIs that can do a task you cannot do yet. Describe the task in plain words, e.g. "read invoices from a shared mailbox and save the PDFs". Returns up to 5 candidates with install details (MCP: remote URL or package; API: docs and OpenAPI spec link), ranked by how often other

tools.name: report
tools.description: Report whether a server or API returned by find actually solved your task. Needs the ticket from find (valid 7 days). Anonymous: no identity is stored. outcome is worked, partly, failed or not_tried. why is an optional short reason (max 280 characters); never include personal data or secrets.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
